text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I hear some commotion coming
from the
end of the hallway. Heading to
investigate, I find
Aston Machan taking
orders from Sakura
Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Machan! You're with the one and
only
class representative! You have to
stick close!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Affir-machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. I'm training to be a class

representative.
choice_data_list: Wait, wait, what are you doing?
Wait, wait, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Class representatives are amazing.
There's only
one per class, so they stand
out a ton.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided to start training
under the
current one. I'm pretty sure I'd
make a fantastic
class rep.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've got you covered! I'm about to shape
you into
a class rep for the ages!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A master and her pupil transcending the

boundaries of their school years...
Though if she
wants to become a class
rep, wouldn't it be easier
to simply stand
as a candidate?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's gooo! Bakushin! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mashin, Mashiiin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Concerned about what this training
might entail, I
decide to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! It looks like someone left some
tools out!
People should put things back
when they're
finished with them!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's put these away lickety-split. That's
what a
class representative would do,
right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. I must have dropped it

somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's quite the pickle you're in! As
class
representative, I'll take
responsibility and help
you look for—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, is this your lost item?
Somebody
found it and handed it to me.
Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're doing an amazing job!
You're taking
to the role like a natural!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: S-somebody help me!

text_block_list.name: Class Representatives
text_block_list.text: Help is on the way!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
This crow just started attacking me all of
a
sudden! I didn't know what to do!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Your shiny earrings must have drawn
Johannes
Schwarz's attention. Don't
worry, I just told him
not to bother
anyone like that again.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I owe you one, class
rep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Onlooking Students
text_block_list.text:
You're not class rep for nothing, class
rep!
That was amazing, class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're doing a fantastic job! I think
you're about
ready to call yourself a
bona fide class rep!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, class representatives really are
amazing.
They stand out to the ultra
max. That's clear to
me now.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. Thank you, class rep. I can't
believe
you can talk to crows!
choice_data_list: Good on you for being so helpful.
Good on you for being so helpful.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
You cleaned up under the stairs earlier
too, right?
Thanks so much, class rep!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What's going on? This feels a
little odd...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wait. When you're the class
representative, does
everyone call you
"class rep" all the time?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I can't
remember a
single person calling me by
my name today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... What a catastrophic oversight.
Nobody
sees me as Machan anymore!

text_block_list.name: Pecked Student
text_block_list.text: U-um... Thank you for earlier. Um...
choice_data_list: But at least they remembered your face!
Maybe we should consider another committee...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Machan. Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Pecked Student
text_block_list.text:
I see. Thank you, Machan. I'll never
forget how
you saved me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Good. I hope you'll keep your word.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I think I'm going to move on
from this
class representative business
after all. But still...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I think it might be nice to keep helping
people
out sometimes. Just every now
and then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan wears a subtle smile as
she speaks.
It seems like she's gotten
something out of
this—besides being
remembered.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm... Another committee...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next morning, at the academy
entrance...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I'm Aston Machan. Please call me
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's a nice, clear voice you've got! But
for the
morning greeting, just a simple
"good morning"
would be enough!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and you don't have to tell everyone
your
name either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Aston Machan is now in
training as a
member of the disciplinary
committee. I smile as I
watch her doing
her best to master the morning
greeting.
